title: chore(dep-sec): js-yaml 4.3.1 -> 4.3.2 (DEP-SEC-001 / Tranche B) + residual-matrix corrections
intent: Bounded DEP-SEC-001 / Tranche B maintenance under explicit owner authorization. Clears Dependabot alert #89 (HIGH, js-yaml CVE-2026-84375) by moving the resolved js-yaml from 4.3.1 to 4.3.2 -- a patch bump inside the existing major, requiring no toolchain migration. Also corrects three statements in the authoritative residual matrix that today's re-grounding proves wrong. Not a new investigation and not a new governance regime: the corrections are to the authoritative record, exposed by the same re-grounding that authorized the bump.
behavior_change: none. js-yaml is a transitive DEVELOPMENT dependency (eslint and @eslint/eslintrc, both requesting ^4.1.0, which 4.3.2 satisfies). It is not reachable from any shipped client bundle. Lockfile audited by enumeration against base df39c4f3, not by reading the diff view: entries 412 before and 412 after, added=0, removed=0, and exactly ONE entry differs in ANY field -- node_modules/js-yaml (version, resolved, integrity). No package.json change; the declared dependency set is untouched.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package-lock.json changes exactly three lines in the node_modules/js-yaml entry: version 4.3.1 -> 4.3.2, resolved tarball URL, and integrity hash. The integrity was cross-checked against two independent sources -- npm's own resolution and `npm view js-yaml@4.3.2 dist.integrity` -- which agree exactly. The residual matrix gains a dated section 8a and three corrected rows.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No existing manifest covers this diff. Authored per CBSP21-NOBORROW-001, which refuses a manifest written for other work even when that manifest's declared paths would cover these files.

verification.known_failure_attributed: src/testing/__tests__/nodeEngineFloor.spec.ts fails locally with SyntaxError. NOT caused here and NOT a repository defect. Attributed by control, not by inheriting the prior claim: with the lockfile change reverted and `git status` clean, the same spec fails identically. The file is valid UTF-8 (18 non-ASCII bytes, all E2 80 94 em-dashes, no BOM) and the reported position (line 4 col 31) is ordinary ASCII, so the location is misattributed by the transform. Windows-only; green on Linux CI. Independently recorded as pre-existing in .cbsp21/patches/tailwind-v4-migration.json and landed that way via #307.
